contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ CONSTA[---]NOB C ; R/ BEATA TRANQVILLITAS

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constantine II (317-340), Beata Tranquillitas issue of 321-323, Reece period 16; London mint, Sear volume 5 page 91 no. 12148 [type]. Obverse description: Bust laureate cuirassed left. Obverse inscription: CONSTA[---]NOB C. Reverse description: Globe on altar inscribed VOT/IS/XX, a letter or pellet to either side of altar; CR suggests F B. Reverse inscription: BEATA TRANQVILLITAS. In exergue: PLON. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 18.9mm, Weight: 1.87gms, die axis: 6
